_readme: Fill a value with a string to replace {{KEY}} on the page (null = still pending, shown as an amber dashed placeholder). Link keys turn the dashed 'soon' button into a normal button. Never invent numbers: copy them from docs/crew/insights/INSIGHTS.md or the run's report.md.

values.FINDING_HEADLINE: Cups, mugs, glasses and ramekins loaded mouth up came out clean 0 times in 11 and kept 49% of their soil; mouth down, 26 of 26 came out clean.
values.FINDING_N: 108 deterministic washes; 73 classifiable (26 mouth down, 8 on side, 11 mouth up drinkware/ramekins; plus bowls)
values.RESIDUE_DELTA: 49% of soil left mouth up (95% CI 28–71%) vs 0% mouth down
values.WATER_ML: 224 ml per item mouth up (bowls: 1.17 L each) vs 0 ml mouth down
values.INSIGHTS_ABLATIONS: No single rule carries a significant effect (all p ≥ 0.39). The best variant was the champion without R1.1, the superstition: 0.552, +0.08 vs. baseline, not significant.
values.INSIGHTS_TRANSFER: The champion genome on other loaders, against their own baseline: DeepSeek-V4-Flash +15 pp (8 wins / 3 losses, p = 0.23), gpt-oss-120b +8 pp (p = 0.75). Both not significant.
values.INSIGHTS_PHYSICS_MAP: Pots are the hardest items: mouth up they kept 95–100% of their soil and held 2–7 L of water. Bowls were left out 21 of 21 times, although every bowl kind washes clean mouth down. Finding 1 is stronger at the official tier (spot check): a mug and a tumbler mouth up kept 90% and 89% of their soil; mouth down, both came out clean.
